name: PR Overview renders the Why + Risk Brief card and its not-generated state
description: From PR #482, the Overview tab (default) mounts the Why + Risk Brief card. Seed data has no pr_why_risk_brief row, so GET /pulls/:id/brief returns { brief: null } and the card shows its explicit 'not generated yet' state with a regenerate affordance (AC-33). Read-only seeded data — the regenerate button is asserted but never clicked (a click would trigger a model call, forbidden here). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
